title: Collect a deposit on an approved estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.chapter: Put a deposit on the estimate
steps.narration: Collect a deposit online as soon as a client approves an estimate.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: On Estimates, click the estimate's number.

steps.caption: Edit
steps.narration: Choose Edit.

steps.caption: Deposit
steps.narration: Under Deposit, type the amount you want up front.

steps.caption: Save
steps.narration: Then save your changes.

steps.caption: The client's screen
steps.narration: Now your client's screen. They open the estimate from the link in their email.

steps.caption: Their name
steps.narration: To approve, they type their name.

steps.caption: Approve
steps.narration: And choose Approve this estimate.

steps.caption: Pay your deposit
steps.narration: Right away, their page offers Pay your deposit.

steps.caption: Back in the CRM
steps.narration: You can also send the link yourself. In the CRM, open the client.

steps.caption: Take a payment
steps.narration: Choose Take a payment.

steps.caption: Create deposit link
steps.narration: Then Create deposit link.

steps.caption: The link
steps.narration: Copy the link, and text or email it to your client.

steps.caption: The client opens the link
steps.narration: Either way, your client lands on the secure checkout page. In this demo, it is a stand-in page.

steps.caption: Checkout
steps.narration: It shows the deposit, and who it is paid to.

steps.caption: Card
steps.narration: They choose bank account or card.

steps.caption: Pay
steps.narration: And pay.

steps.caption: Back on the estimate
steps.narration: Their estimate page now says Payment received.

steps.caption: Payments
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, open Payments.

steps.caption: Recent payments
steps.narration: The deposit is in Recent payments, marked succeeded.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find Payments in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to collect a deposit on an approved estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Put a deposit on an estimate in ConstructHUB CRM, see the Pay your deposit button your client gets when they approve, and create a deposit link to send yourself. The payment then shows on your Payments page. Recorded in a demo workspace with a demonstration checkout page in place of the real hosted checkout.
